name: Multiple Importance Sampling for Volumetric Path Tracing
aliases: Light sampling with Multiple Importance Sampling
Multiple Importance Sampling (MIS) for Volumetric Path Tracing
Volume Path Tracing Direct Lighting Estimation with MIS
definition: A technique to combine contributions from different sampling strategies (phase function sampling and next event estimation) using the power heuristic to reduce variance in volumetric path tracing, particularly when skipping index-matching surfaces.
